purpose: Compress the backward spiral audit from R50F to R1, retain only falsification-resistant mechanisms, quarantine failed or over-broad interpretations, and isolate the exact remaining theorem obligation.

central_result.why_not: No checked lineage proves universal exact polynomial progress for every reachable state of one fixed total 3SAT controller.
central_result.U: forall F in R_W4: R33_PROGRESS_OR_TERMINAL(F) OR exists v R49H_SAFE(F,v) OR exists v R47J_SAFE(F,v)
central_result.if_U_is_proved: Together with the existing exactness, explicit-state polynomial envelope, exhaustive polynomial pivot scan, strict variable descent, replay, and witness reconstruction obligations, U would yield a polynomial 3SAT decider and therefore P=NP.
central_result.firewall: R44AJ establishes that a universal exact polynomial invariant-descent machine is equivalent in strength to the P=NP target; U must not receive authority from finite coverage.

keep: R1: representation/order sensitivity is real; family-specific polynomial discovery does not imply universal discovery.
R6: exponential or unbounded primitives require a proved polynomial bound or quarantine from theorem authority.
R31: theorem-first O1-O12 contract and complete resource charging.
R33: proof-carrying local reductions with reconstruction and explicit STALLED status.
R34: exact affine/XOR recognition and GF2 certified terminal for the recognized language.
R44AJ: exact invariant-descent characterization of the final target.
R44BA: genuine one-step low-surplus exact progress theorem with explicit scope firewall.
R49H: local exact width-4 Davis-Putnam safe-pivot theorem when chi_star<=4.
R47J: exact DP followed by certified R33/affine/RUP normalization to a fixpoint, with independent replay and reconstruction.
R50A: truth-blind exhaustive current-variable controller; fixed integer-ID order is reproducibility only, not proof authority.
R50E: wide resolvents require long-parent structure; short-parent protection is exact local combinatorics.
R50F: wide-clause disappearance must carry a replayable killer certificate; disappearance alone is not authority.
discard_or_quarantine: Any fixed ROBDD order or single representation language as a universal polynomial solution without a uniform construction theorem.
Finite caps, timeout success, benchmark scaling, holdout success, or no-counterexample-found as asymptotic proof.
Heuristic, learned, random, semantic-number, or post-hoc pivot ranking as theorem authority.
R49O's exact-4-CNF and min_polarity_side>=3 generator restrictions as a universal deadcore search space.
Treating the R50C same-lineage one-swap holdout as family-independent confirmation.
Treating TOP2_MIN_TAUTO or any finite transfer feature as a theorem.
Treating certificate improvement as capability improvement when no new semantic rule was added.
Treating a one-step theorem as an invariant-closed iterative decider.
Treating variable-ID-dependent trajectory observations as structural invariants without relabeling controls.

surviving_machine_core.state: finite canonical explicit CNF with persisted maximum width <=4
surviving_machine_core.lane_1: R33 terminal or certified strict reduction
surviving_machine_core.lane_2: R49H exact DP when a recomputed bipolar pivot has chi_star<=4
surviving_machine_core.lane_3: otherwise exhaustive exact R47J evaluation over every current pivot
surviving_machine_core.successor_authority: terminal OR no-fresh-variable strict-variable-descent successor with final maximum width <=4 and independent replay
surviving_machine_core.reconstruction: reverse R33/DP/R47J traces to a directly verified SAT assignment
surviving_machine_core.failure: OPEN after every current pivot is checked and no authorized successor exists

new_spiral_deductions: In W4, a non-tautological resolvent wider than 4 cannot arise from two parents of width <=3. At least one parent must have width 4 and the opposite parent must have width >=3.
Therefore BAD(v) is contained in (P4(v) x N>=3(v)) union (P>=3(v) x N4(v)); width-6 requires a width4 x width4 parent pair.
If a pivot has no width-4 parent occurrence, every retained cross resolvent has width <=4, so that pivot is an R49H-safe pivot.
Any no-R49H hard state therefore has every variable incident to at least one width-4 clause and to an opposite-polarity width>=3 parent in a retained bad pair.

If the current formula has at most 5 variables, every non-tautological pivot resolvent uses at most 4 remaining variables, hence chi_star<=4 for every bipolar pivot. Thus a genuine W4 no-R49H/R47J deadcore must have at least 6 variables.
